statement: Change a setting, assignment or conversion in text object editing with "Set Case"; the new value is stored in the document, takes effect in dependent results, and one undo step restores the previous value.

Switch visibility, lock, mute or expansion state in text object editing with "Toggle Case"; the changed state is visible in the UI and the output, it is saved with the document, and one undo step restores it.

Change a setting, assignment or conversion in text object editing with "Change Character"; the new value is stored in the document, takes effect in dependent results, and one undo step restores the previous value.

Change a setting, assignment or conversion in text object editing with "Change Spacing"; the new value is stored in the document, takes effect in dependent results, and one undo step restores the previous value.
Remove or clear content in text object editing with "Delete"; the targeted data is gone afterwards, unrelated data is untouched, references to it are left valid, and one undo step restores it.
Use "Line Break" in text object editing; the document ends in the state Blender 5.3 produces for the same input and one undo step restores the previous state.

Reposition or reshape the current selection in text object editing with "Move Cursor"; the resulting positions or shapes match Blender 5.3 for the same input, only the selected items change, and one undo step restores them.

Reposition or reshape the current selection in text object editing with "Move Select"; the resulting positions or shapes match Blender 5.3 for the same input, only the selected items change, and one undo step restores them.

Bring content into the document in text object editing with "Open Font"; the content is available afterwards with its values intact, missing or broken sources are reported rather than skipped silently, and one undo step reverts the document.
Change what is selected in text object editing with "Select All"; the new selection is what the next edit command acts on, no data is modified, and one undo step restores the previous selection.
Change what is selected in text object editing with "Select Word"; the new selection is what the next edit command acts on, no data is modified, and one undo step restores the previous selection.

Change a setting, assignment or conversion in text object editing with "Set Selection"; the new value is stored in the document, takes effect in dependent results, and one undo step restores the previous value.

Change a setting, assignment or conversion in text object editing with "Set Style"; the new value is stored in the document, takes effect in dependent results, and one undo step restores the previous value.

Switch visibility, lock, mute or expansion state in text object editing with "Toggle Style"; the changed state is visible in the UI and the output, it is saved with the document, and one undo step restores it.
Copy content in text object editing with "Copy Text"; the copy has the same values as its source, the source is unchanged, and one undo step removes the copy.

Run the data operation "Cut Text" on the current selection in text object editing; the resulting data matches Blender 5.3 for the same input, the operation reports a clear error when the input is invalid, and one undo step restores the original.

Create new content in text object editing with "Insert Text"; the new item exists in the document afterwards with the values Blender 5.3 gives it, is the active or selected item where Blender makes it so, and one undo step removes it.

Create new content in text object editing with "Insert Unicode"; the new item exists in the document afterwards with the values Blender 5.3 gives it, is the active or selected item where Blender makes it so, and one undo step removes it.
Paste previously copied content in text object editing with "Paste Text"; the pasted items match what was copied, land where Blender 5.3 puts them, and one undo step removes them.
Paste previously copied content in text object editing with "Paste File"; the pasted items match what was copied, land where Blender 5.3 puts them, and one undo step removes them.

Create new content in text object editing with "Add Text Box"; the new item exists in the document afterwards with the values Blender 5.3 gives it, is the active or selected item where Blender makes it so, and one undo step removes it.

Remove or clear content in text object editing with "Remove Text Box"; the targeted data is gone afterwards, unrelated data is untouched, references to it are left valid, and one undo step restores it.
Remove or clear content in text object editing with "Unlink"; the targeted data is gone afterwards, unrelated data is untouched, references to it are left valid, and one undo step restores it.
